answer_schema.rows: array of requested customer summary objects

task: Summarize all purchases for customer IDs [21, 22, 23, 24] in chinook. Return rows with customer_id,order_count (distinct orders/invoices),item_count (sum of line quantities),total_amount (sum of line price times quantity, applying line Discount in Northwind; round to 2 decimals). Also return largest: the customer ID with greatest total_amount; ties lexicographic ID.
